title: Min Stack
description: Parallel stack of running minimums alongside the value stack so getMin is O(1).

notes: mins[i] is the minimum of vals[0..i].
Push to mins on EVERY push so the two stacks stay the same length.
On the first push, fall back to Infinity — never read the top of an empty mins stack.

questions.q: Why push to mins on EVERY push, even when x is not the new min?
options: So mins and vals stay the same length — pop drops one from each
Global minimum of all values ever pushed

questions.q: What is the new value pushed to mins on push(x)?
options: Math.min(previousMin, x), or x if mins is empty

blanks.hint: safe fallback when mins is empty

L3.prompt: Implement a MinStack class with push, pop, top, and getMin all O(1). Then run: push(-2), push(0), push(-3), log getMin(), pop(), log top(), log getMin().
hints: Keep a parallel stack of running mins.
Push to both stacks on every push, pop from both on every pop.
